## Welcome to Berry College,   
a place shaped by an enduring mission.
**“We educate the head, heart and hands — to inspire leaders of integrity who cultivate thriving communities.”**
For the Berry family, our mission is not just an inscription on a plaque. It is a life posture that drives and directs us.
Since its founding in 1902, the Berry education model has invited students to balance intellectual exploration, hands-on learning and character development while contributing to the life of the college and the broader world.
Set on the world’s largest college campus, we offer an environment unlike any other in higher education. Our forests, fields, meadows and streams are not a backdrop but rather a core part of the learning experience.
At Berry, students study and discover alongside faculty and staff mentors, engage in hands-on research and creative work, and develop a strong sense of responsibility. Education at Berry extends beyond the classroom, inviting students to reflect, to practice and to grow through experience.
Through LifeWorks, every student can participate in paid, meaningful work that connects learning with leadership and calling. These experiences foster competence and clarity as Berry graduates leave prepared for careers and thoughtful engagement with their communities.
At the heart of this institution is a vibrant and connected community. Berry is home to students who are known and supported, faculty and staff who are deeply invested in mentoring and care, and alumni who remain connected to the mission long after graduation.
Berry College is one-of-a-kind. It’s a wonderful place to call home. We invite you to come see for yourself.
President Sandeep Mazumder
